title: Contact | Dreamfarmcommons
plain_text:
The gallery is generally open 1-6PM
Friday - Saturday
​
349 15th Street in between Webster and Harrison downtown Oakland
Since our schedule changes with different works we suggest emailing to confirm before visitingDream Farm CommonsThanks! Message sent.SendAccessibility Information
Dream Farm Commons is located on 15th Street, which is a one way street, between Harrison and Webster in a storefront space in the White Building. The single entrance into the street level gallery space is accessible by wheelchair and/or scooter. The upstairs loft is accessed by a flight of stairs that are each about 7”. Metered street parking is available on 15th Street, Webster, Harrison and the surrounding area Monday-Saturday (free on Sundays + weekdays after 6PM). We are located nearby 19th Street Bart (0.3 mi), 12th Street Bart (0.2 mi), NL AC Transit bus, 62 AC Transit bus, and 51A AC Transit bus. (We are happy to help with any other accessibility/direction needs.)
Individual restrooms are in the basement (one level below the street) via stairs or elevator at the lobby of the White Building. The lobby is located three doors down the block from DFC’s front door and a code will be provided to enter. The stairs and elevator are directly across from the entrance of the lobby, (stairs to the left, elevator to the right) the stairs are each about 7” tall and winding. Dream Farm Commons is not a scent free space.
